best_idea: Split one kill's XP by damage share among the attackers still alive when the target dies, with a party-of-the-killer pass that pools party hate, scales the pooled XP by a small per-member bonus, and weights each known member's cut by level squared.
decision_why: Frankendom's many-on-one fights (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3) need one server-side split of each kill's XP over a bounded hate list; we take the hate-as-damage share, the dead-attacker pruning before the total, and the level-squared party weight, and reject the pet and summon steal, the lawful and karma side effects, and the party XP leak.
acceptance: In a three-attacker kill (A 60 damage, B 30, C 10 but C is dead before the kill), a server test asserts that A is awarded 2/3 and B 1/3 of the kill XP, C is awarded nothing, and the awards sum to the kill XP with at most one point lost per recipient.
